findings.title: Highest Gross Profit Item (Analysis Period)
findings.claim: Iced Spanish Latte generated an estimated 4011.00 SAR gross profit (estimated 71.5% margin) from 285 units sold at 5607.00 SAR revenue during 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-18, based on menu-declared unit cost of 5.6 SAR (no recipe/BOM verification available).
coverage_notes: Menu unit_cost_sar used as proxy for COGS; no recipe/BOM available
Item ICE-001 had 285 transactions in period
assumptions: Menu unit_cost_sar is current and accurate for the analysis period
No recipe/BOM available; unit cost treated as declared in menu
Unit cost applies uniformly across all units sold in period
No waste or portion control drift between menu cost and actual COGS

findings.title: Supplier Price Change Detected
findings.claim: Supplier price change for Barista oat: 15.40 SAR/L → 17.90 SAR/L (delta: 2.50 SAR, 16.23% change), effective 2026-05-01. Without recipe/BOM and standing order volumes, per-unit cost impact on menu items cannot be calculated.
assumptions: Price change extracted from supplier email is accurate
Effective date reflects when new price takes effect
No recipe/BOM available; cannot calculate per-drink cost impact
Standing order volumes and payment terms unknown; procurement scenario not calculated

findings.title: Highest Waste Cost Item (Analysis Period)
findings.claim: Halloumi Toast had the highest waste cost of 385.40 SAR from 47 units wasted at 8.2 SAR/unit during 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-18. Total waste cost across 6 items: 1194.10 SAR (193 units).
coverage_notes: Waste cost ranking (all items): [{'item': 'Halloumi Toast', 'waste_cost_sar': 385.4}, {'item': 'Butter Croissant', 'waste_cost_sar': 304.0}, {'item': 'Chicken Sandwich', 'waste_cost_sar': 237.5}, {'item': 'Cheesecake Slice', 'waste_cost_sar': 119.0}, {'item': 'Date Cake', 'waste_cost_sar': 97.2}, {'item': 'Cinnamon Roll', 'waste_cost_sar': 51.0}]
Unit costs sourced from inventory.parquet for the analysis period
Refunds and dead sensors not explicitly filtered from inventory; assume inventory records are clean
assumptions: Unit cost from inventory (SAR/unit) represents the COGS applicable to units wasted during this period
Waste records in inventory are accurate and exclude non-waste adjustments
Unit cost is uniform across all wasted units for each item
No recipe/BOM available; waste valuation uses inventory unit cost as proxy for COGS
